response.sql: WITH order_counts AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM `order` GROUP BY account_id), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_count FROM order_counts), above_avg AS (SELECT oc.account_id, oc.order_count, oa.avg_count FROM order_counts AS oc CROSS JOIN overall_avg AS oa WHERE oc.order_count > oa.avg_count), above_avg_mean AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_count FROM above_avg) SELECT a.account_id, a.order_count, a.order_count - a.avg_count AS above_overall_average, a.order_count - m.avg_count AS above_above_average_mean FROM above_avg AS a CROSS JOIN above_avg_mean AS m ORDER BY above_above_average_mean DESC, a.account_id LIMIT 10
